verdict.rationale: Sketch offers several programmatic surfaces that reach much of the Mac app: an official JavaScript API, an internal API to drop down to when needed, the `sketchtool` CLI, a `sketch://` URL scheme, an open JSON-based file format, and a built-in local MCP server for AI clients. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI, and no public web/REST API is evidenced for Workspace actions such as sharing, starred versions or permissions (OpenAPI probes all returned 404). Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, a documented web/Workspace API covering collaboration, versioning and admin features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
